t: This bronze statue shows Thomas Carlyle, the Scottish essayist, historian and philosopher known as the sage of Chelsea. It stands in Chelsea Embankment Gardens, and Joseph Edgar Boehm made it. It was erected in 1881 and unveiled in 1882. It stands close to 24 Cheyne Row, where Carlyle lived for the last forty-seven years of his life. His writings strongly influenced the intellectual and artistic culture of the Victorian era. The statue has been Grade II listed since 1969.
